title: Finite quotient and predictive-equivalence calculator
purpose: Compute current and bounded predictive partitions and emit distinguishing probes.
input_types: Finite deterministic or finitely branching transition system; typed input alphabet; public lens; finite probe family; exact horizon H.
outputs: Current partition, predictive partition, refinement map, reachable-image restriction, and a minimal distinguishing input/probe word for every separated pair.
witness_format: Canonical state IDs; partition blocks; JSON trace certificates; pair→word table; exact reachability set.
controls: Same partition under relabeling; unreachable-state insertion; public-equal/predictive-distinct MF-01 pair; complete-interface control.
complexity: Polynomial partition refinement for a fixed finite probe family and horizon; O(H·|U|·|X|²) simple reference bound, with exponential word growth avoided by dynamic signatures.
falsifies: A proposed predictive bridge that identifies states separated by an admitted future probe, or a claim that current equality already supplies future sufficiency.
lean_role: Prove the definition, partition properties, and certificate checker soundness on finite types.
python_role: Enumerate partitions and emit human-readable distinguishing traces.
nonclaim: The calculator does not choose the consciousness-relevant probe family.

title: Cross-carrier simulation and bisimulation checker
purpose: Check saturated typed relations between distinct finite carriers and produce a failing transition witness.
input_types: Two finite transition systems; state relation R; input/clock maps; public or predictive observation maps; reachability scopes.
outputs: simulation/bisimulation verdict; saturation verdict; unmatched source or target step; largest simulation relation when requested.
witness_format: Counterexample tuple (x,u,x',y) or (y,u,y',x); relation table; quotient-level relation; exact path prefix.
controls: Identity on a relabeled same carrier; MF-01 positive bridge; hidden counterfeit; relation totality only on reachable states.
complexity: Standard finite greatest-fixed-point elimination, polynomial in |X_S|·|X_T|·|U| for deterministic systems.
falsifies: A claimed cross-carrier preservation relation lacking a matching step, saturation, or typed interface compatibility.
lean_role: Formalize soundness of the checker and quotient descent conditions.
python_role: Compute maximal relations and export counterexample traces.
nonclaim: Bisimulation of a selected object is not full-package realization or lineage.

title: Continuation-relation and branch classifier
purpose: Derive SF-02 overlap lineage and SF-03 ancestry as separate relations on one operational episode graph.
input_types: Finite event/provenance graph; stage supports; process signatures; mixed-step/nonredundancy predicate; ancestry seed and monotone closure rules.
outputs: Overlap relation L_O; least ancestry relation L_A; branch/fusion/empty-target classifications; disagreement set between criteria.
witness_format: Path/corridor certificate, seed derivation tree, closure iteration number, branch adjacency list, and nonreachability cut.
controls: MF-02 live handoff; MF-03 destructive reconstruction and independent twin; MF-04 symmetry; MF-06 fission/fusion.
complexity: Graph reachability plus finite least-fixed-point iteration; polynomial in graph and relation-lattice size for fixed rule arity, with automorphism checking optionally exponential.
falsifies: A lineage definition that classifies an independent twin, returns unique continuation under exact symmetry, or treats every data edge as mixed-process overlap.
lean_role: Define the two relations, prove leastness/closure and key structural laws.
python_role: Compute relation closures and display derivation witnesses/disagreements.
nonclaim: The program classifies structural relations only; it does not decide personal identity.

title: Bridge-composition and confluence checker
purpose: Compare direct and factored bridges and enumerate replacement-order critical pairs.
input_types: Finite carrier-stage graph; typed edge bridges; composition operation; retained object; local compatibility and clock maps.
outputs: Composable/not-composable verdict; composite relation/map; direct-versus-composite comparison; critical-pair joinability table.
witness_format: Two explicit paths, their induced maps/relations, first disagreement state, and an unjoinable critical-pair diagram.
controls: MF-02 concatenable corridors; MF-08 flat and nonflat variants; same bridge factored through an identity stage.
complexity: Polynomial for one declared pair of paths; potentially exponential when enumerating all paths/critical pairs in an unrestricted finite graph.
falsifies: A functorial or transitive claim whose composite disagrees with the direct bridge or fails a typed boundary condition.
lean_role: Prove composition laws under explicit compatibility hypotheses and encode counterexamples otherwise.
python_role: Enumerate finite paths/critical pairs and emit disagreement certificates.
nonclaim: Confluence of one retained object does not establish full package preservation.

title: Route-holonomy finder
purpose: Detect nontrivial loop action and test path independence on a finite route graph.
input_types: Connected finite route graph; edge maps or relations on a finite retained object; optional spanning tree and basepoint.
outputs: Cycle-basis loop actions; flat/nonflat verdict; endpoint path-disagreement witnesses; generated holonomy monoid table when finite.
witness_format: Closed edge word, initial object value, final unequal value, and two endpoint-equal paths with different transports.
controls: MF-08 one-flip model; compensating-flip flat control; quotient that intentionally forgets route memory.
complexity: Polynomial cycle-basis construction; evaluating all object states is O((|E|-|V|+1)·|O|); full loop-monoid closure may be exponential.
falsifies: An unqualified route-independence claim or a bridge-composition law that ignores retained path memory.
lean_role: Prove the cycle-basis sufficiency lemma under invertible edge maps and formalize explicit nonflat witnesses.
python_role: Compute cycle actions and shortest disagreement loops.
nonclaim: Holonomy is relative to the selected retained object and route graph.

title: Recombination-factorization tester
purpose: Determine whether joint probes factor through branch marginals and produce parity/correlation counterexamples.
input_types: Finite joint source states; branch projection maps; target branch states; recombination map; finite joint probe family.
outputs: Branchwise preservation table; factorization verdict for each joint probe; recombination preservation verdict; minimal distinguishing joint state pair.
witness_format: Two source/joint assignments with equal marginals and unequal probe value; projection and recombination tables.
controls: MF-06 XOR parity; a factorable sum probe; missing-branch data; equal versus conflicting credit labels.
complexity: O(|X_joint|²·|Π_joint|) by exhaustive finite comparison; exponential in branch count when joint state is represented as a product.
falsifies: A claim that branchwise or pairwise matching automatically preserves binding, recombination, or fusion provenance.
lean_role: Formalize factorization and the finite parity counterexample.
python_role: Search joint tables and emit minimal counterexample pairs.
nonclaim: A passed probe family may still omit other joint structure.

title: C-package clause-preservation and gluing auditor
purpose: Audit clause-local witnesses, target ownership, overlap compatibility, global gluing, and hard gates without collapsing them into one Boolean input.
input_types: Finite clause scopes; source/target witness tables; typed bridge maps; overlap restrictions; dependency hypergraph; hard-gate list; ownership graph.
outputs: Per-clause preservation results; overlap disagreement witnesses; running-intersection status; global witness or obstruction; target-owned package verdict.
witness_format: Clause ledger, overlap table, join tree or minimal inconsistent cycle, ownership dependency path, and final package certificate.
controls: MF-05 shallow certificate counterfeit; MF-06 marginal/global mismatch; MF-07 autonomous target and shadow.
complexity: Polynomial join/gluing on acyclic/running-intersection hypergraphs; general finite CSP/gluing may be exponential and must be reported as such.
falsifies: A full-package claim with one failed clause, inconsistent overlap, absent global section, or externally owned final witness.
lean_role: Prove acyclic gluing and modular preservation lemmas on explicit finite scopes.
python_role: Construct join trees, solve finite witness CSPs, and display obstructions.
nonclaim: A structural package certificate does not prove certificate soundness or consciousness.

title: Bridge-removal and autonomy checker
purpose: Apply a declared withdrawal intervention and compute target viability/package survival from retained target resources only.
input_types: Finite target transition/control system; ownership-labeled dependencies; withdrawal set; allowed disturbances; horizon or invariant-region request; package predicate.
outputs: Post-withdrawal transition system; reachable set; maximal invariant/controlled-invariant set; first failure trace; dependency residues.
witness_format: Removed-edge list, target-owned resource closure, invariant-set certificate, or shortest path to failure/sink.
controls: MF-02 target-only cycle; MF-03 gap; MF-07 autonomous versus decoder shadow; MF-10 repair boundary.
complexity: Polynomial reachability and greatest-fixed-point computation on explicit finite state graphs; exponential only if the state product is given succinctly.
falsifies: A target-autonomy claim that fails after removing source, bridge, decoder, scheduler, repair service, or controller named by the protocol.
lean_role: Prove invariant-set soundness and formalize the withdrawal transformation.
python_role: Compute reachable/invariant sets and shortest collapse traces.
nonclaim: Finite-horizon autonomy does not imply indefinite persistence beyond the declared model/disturbance class.

title: Adequacy-residual and blind-spot calculator
purpose: Track typed local defects, hard gates, margins, and composition instead of one similarity score.
input_types: Exact rational defect vector; coordinate semantics; local thresholds and hard gates; stage composition law; optional probe coverage matrix.
outputs: Coordinatewise pass/fail; scalar summaries clearly marked nonauthoritative; margin erosion; composed bound; uncovered blind-spot coordinates.
witness_format: Exact fraction table, failing coordinate, hard-gate trace, and two-stage arithmetic certificate.
controls: MF-01 hidden predictive defect; MF-09 small scalar/large local defect; MF-10 zero-margin boundary.
complexity: Polynomial exact rational arithmetic for declared coordinates; counterexample search over omitted coordinates depends on finite model size.
falsifies: A stability or approximate-preservation claim violated by a local hard gate, unmodeled blind spot, or failed composition bound.
lean_role: Prove coordinatewise/order lemmas and any selected finite-horizon stability theorem.
python_role: Evaluate vectors, search small counterexamples, and produce exact rational reports.
nonclaim: The tool does not determine which defect coordinates are ontologically sufficient.

title: Finite counterexample and minimal-witness enumerator
purpose: Systematically search bounded finite carriers for the smallest positive witness or failure of a proposed implication.
input_types: Bounded state counts; typed carrier/bridge schema; candidate predicates; symmetry constraints; theorem antecedent and negated consequent.
outputs: Smallest model by declared size order; complete transition/bridge tables; isomorphism-reduced witness class; UNSAT/exhaustion record within bounds.
witness_format: Canonical finite structure, theorem-field truth table, automorphism group summary, and reproducible enumeration parameters.
controls: Seed every MF-01…MF-10 witness; recover known symmetry/parity/holonomy counterexamples; verify no false witness under a strengthened premise.
complexity: Worst-case exponential or superexponential in state bound; symmetry reduction and SAT/SMT encoding are optional later engineering choices.
falsifies: Any conjecture admitting a bounded exact counterexample, and any claimed minimality defeated by a smaller witness.
lean_role: Consume exported witnesses as explicit finite examples and prove checker certificates, not trust the enumerator as an oracle.
python_role: Enumerate, reduce by isomorphism, and export candidate witnesses/counterexamples.
nonclaim: Failure to find a bounded counterexample is not a proof of the unbounded conjecture.
